title: US Economic Perspectives - Resilient growth meets sticky inflation in the latest Beige Book

classification.rationale: The note scores the August Beige Book for growth, labor, inflation and recession sentiment, then links it to the Fed's expected September and December hikes.
classification.runner_up_reason: The conclusion is a call for two 25bp Fed hikes to 4.1%, but the bulk of the note is Beige Book activity and inflation sentiment analysis.
